payload.scope:
i5b takes on:
- DEFAULT provisioning: remove the opt-in so every se_loop_start creates iter/<id> in .worktrees/ (keep only the never-nest guard).
- LIVE routing: openInstance spans the worktree homes so the running server/board drives a worktree-resident iteration through next/submit/gate/ship.
- LOCAL top-level machines: lift the iteration-local machine (today only loadIterationMachine for sub-machines) to the iteration's TOP-LEVEL machine - seeded from systematic, trimmed locally, removed states rewired, compile + validate.
- An END-TO-END LIVE test as the acceptance (open -> walk -> gate -> ship inside the worktree, real tools).
- Owner feedback this session (small, folded in): (a) the trim capability above IS what lets a low-deviation iteration SKIP the early framing states; (b) a guidance-text fix on those states - prefer inheriting se.vision (pointer + delta) over re-drafting, per the state-inheritance ruling.
payload.non_goals:
- The general refine/lean strike-list over ANY machine (se.req-lean-strike broader scope): i5b gives the local-trim mechanism; specific trimmed variants ride later.
- Auto-DECIDING which states an iteration may skip (the deviation judgment stays owner/authoring judgment; i5b enables trimming, not the choice).
- The full v1->v2 porting + red-team/validation-regression audit (the next deep retro, note-cc4c498ca67f).
- Two live worktrees at once with two agents (stays i5's owner-physical RAID).
- Phone-connect (re-opens as a fresh iteration after i5b, reusing abandoned i8b).
- Board multi-agent tabs beyond one live stream (i9).
